issue.body:
Hi I'm using fastapi and have a server that accept websockt connections.

I'm testing how many connections (connected and not closed) that server can take.
 
I found out that when my client connections reached to 241, then the server stopped accepting new connections. Adding more client connection will directly close, but there is no messages or exceptions on the server, completely silent on the server side.

Is there any settings of the websocket's connection pool size?
I didn't find it on the document.

Or how can I increase the number of websocket connections (connected and not closed) that server can take.

Thank you very much.
issue.title: WebSocket max connection pool size ?
